home.title: prelaps — free browser tools
home.description: Free tools that run in your browser. No account needed, and nothing you type leaves your device.

tools.mojibake.name: Mojibake Fixer
tools.mojibake.desc: Recover text that turned into garbled characters after being saved or opened with the wrong encoding — EUC-KR read as UTF-8, and other common mismatches.
tools.race.name: Race Roulette
tools.race.desc: Type in names and watch them race. Decide lunch, chores, or who pays — the finish order is your result, and weights show up as boosters you can watch rather than hidden odds.
about.title: About prelaps
about.description: Who builds prelaps and how your data is handled.
about.heading: About
about.p1: prelaps is a one-person side project. I build tools when I need them and put them here.
about.p2: Every tool runs as a static page. Processing happens in your browser, and the text you paste never leaves your device. The site is funded by ads.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy | prelaps
privacy.description: What prelaps collects, what it does not, and how each tool handles what you enter.
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy covers prelaps (prelaps.com) and every tool published on it.
privacy.s1.p1: prelaps does not collect personal information. There is no sign-up and no account.
privacy.s1.p2: Whatever you type or upload is processed entirely inside your browser. This is not only a promise in a document — the site has no server that receives your text. Closing or reloading the page discards it, and no browser storage is used, so nothing is left on your device either.
privacy.s1.p3: Accordingly the following are never collected: name, email address, phone number, account details, the contents of anything you type or upload, or file names.
privacy.ads.p1: The site does not currently serve ads, and no analytics tool is attached.
privacy.ads.p2: Once advertising is introduced, Google and other third-party vendors may use cookies to serve ads based on your prior visits to this and other sites. This document will be updated before that happens, along with whatever consent step is required at the time. Personalised advertising can be turned off at
privacy.fonts.p: Some pages load their typeface from Google Fonts, so opening them sends a request to fonts.googleapis.com and fonts.gstatic.com. Your IP address and browser type may reach Google as part of that request. Only the connection information needed to deliver the font is involved — nothing you typed is included.
privacy.logs.p: The site is served as static files by a hosting provider, which may keep ordinary access logs — IP address, timestamp, requested path — for operation and troubleshooting. The operator does not use these logs to identify individual visitors.
privacy.children.p: The site is not directed at children under 14, and no personal information is collected from visitors of any age.
privacy.rights.p: Because no personal information is stored, there is nothing to request access to, correct, or delete. If you believe otherwise, please get in touch.
privacy.contact.p: Questions about this policy can be sent to
privacy.changes.p: Any change to this policy is reflected on this page together with the date. Changes that actually widen what is collected — introducing advertising or analytics, for example — are written here before they take effect.
privacy.s3.intro: Each tool is listed with what it collects, why, how long it is kept, and whether anything is shared. The answer is currently the same for all of them.
privacy.tool.mojibake.note: Pasted text and uploaded files are decoded in the browser and are never sent anywhere.
privacy.tool.race.name: Race Picker
privacy.tool.race.note: Names and weights you enter stay in the page. Refreshing clears them.
terms.title: Terms of Use | prelaps
terms.description: The conditions for using prelaps and the tools published on it.
terms.heading: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These terms cover prelaps (prelaps.com) and every tool published on it.
terms.what.p: A set of free browser tools run by one person. There is no sign-up, no stored user data, and all processing happens in your browser.
terms.noWarranty.p1: These tools estimate, sort, and transform — they do not certify. Results can be wrong, and each tool page describes where that tool tends to fail.
terms.noWarranty.p2: Keep your own copy of anything that matters before replacing it with a result from here. The operator is not responsible for loss that follows from overwriting an original.
terms.duty.p1: Anyone may use these tools. Please avoid:
terms.duty.li1: Sending automated or excessive requests that interfere with the service
terms.duty.li2: Copying the site wholesale and redistributing it as your own
terms.duty.p2: You keep the rights to, and the responsibility for, whatever you enter. The operator cannot see it.
terms.change.p: This is a free service provided by an individual. Features may change and the service may stop without notice, with no obligation to compensate.
terms.liability.p: To the extent permitted by law, the operator is not liable for direct or indirect damages arising from the use of, or inability to use, these tools. They are provided as is.
terms.law.p: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Korea.
terms.contact.p: Questions about these terms can be sent to
contact.title: Contact | prelaps
contact.description: How to reach the person who runs prelaps.
contact.heading: Contact
contact.email.p: Bug reports, suggestions, and questions about privacy or the terms all go to the same address.
contact.email.note: This is a one-person project, so a reply can take a few days.
contact.report.p: Please say which tool you were using and what you expected to happen. If a tool produced a wrong result, the input that caused it helps most.
contact.report.warn: Please do not send sensitive files. The tools never upload your files, and they are not needed to reproduce a report either.
contact.before.p: Each tool page has a section on where that tool commonly fails. A fair share of reports turn out to be cases the tool cannot fix, because the original information is already gone.
